metadata.title: OneHealth DataSpace Dashboard
metadata.description: Operational lifecycle dashboard for OneHealth DataSpace services.

aria.lifecycleSection: Choose a OneHealth DataSpace lifecycle capability
aria.openService: Open {service} service in a new tab

slogan.line2: A complete operational lifecycle for One Health data.

panel.localNote: This option is shown locally in the dashboard.
panel.emptyPrompt: Select a service to view its role in the lifecycle and access its operational endpoint.

SHARE.title: SHARE
SHARE.description: Securely share data with other participants
SHARE.detail: Use the sharing service for exchanging One Health data with other Data Space participants in an interoperable and trusted way using EDC connectors.

COMPUTE.title: COMPUTE
COMPUTE.detail: Run scalable processing, AI, simulation, and workflow workloads close to governed data.

ANALYZE.title: ANALYZE
ANALYZE.detail: Explore datasets, analyze data, and transform operational data into useful insight using Big Data technologies.

STORE.title: STORE
STORE.description: Store and protect your data assets
STORE.detail: Keep your source data, derived outputs, and other project assets safe in scalable, high-performance, durable storage.

DELIVER.title: DELIVER
DELIVER.description: Expose results as services and applications
DELIVER.detail: Publish applications and service endpoints through private cloud services under your control.

ANONYMIX.title: Anonymix
ANONYMIX.detail: Support controlled anonymization workflows before sensitive data is shared, analyzed, or delivered.

CLEVER.title: Clever
CLEVER.detail: Provide guided support for finding services, understanding next steps, and coordinating lifecycle actions.
